diagnostic_development_sets: Round6 train/validation/test split (old test is no longer final test)

arm_a.checkpoint_rule: minimum validation cross-entropy independently per head

arm_b.change: capacity only relative to Arm A
arm_b.selection: single preregistered seed; no best-of-seeds selection

arm_c.change: quantity-aware actor ledger and sequential market ledger only
arm_c.weights: Arm A checkpoint if trained, otherwise frozen Round6 weights as explicitly named control
arm_c.unknown_opponent_market_orders: not observed; only the $1 guaranteed sale floor is credited for later fixed-cost purchases
arm_c.no_claim: non-differentiable correction is not backpropagated through

phase3_plan.activation: only after learned full-action output emits livestock-related PICKUP, PLACE, BUY_ANIMAL, FEED, CARE, or COLLECT_FERTILIZER
phase3_plan.state: farm-level goal persists; actor assignment is rebuilt from each observation and is not a permanent cross-day worker ID
phase3_plan.completion: feed, care, first/later collection, shed delivery, sale
phase3_plan.interrupt: no animals, violated prerequisites, or day >= 28
phase3_plan.classification: task-completion executor arm; not claimed as pure BC improvement

pilot.purpose: first production and reinvestment diagnostic, not win-rate estimation

promotion.method: seed block bootstrap reported descriptively plus preregistered Hoeffding lower bound
promotion.power_warning: 32 independent blocks cannot put a 60% point estimate above 50% with a one-sided 95% Hoeffding lower bound; about 150 blocks are required
